title: The Two Neighborhood News Desk
learning_focus: Explanation and news report, fact/opinion, comparison, author purpose, supporting details, formal tone, and compound-complex sentences.
story_premise: Two neighboring community events occur in the same month. A careless draft blends their practices together. The Pathfinder must produce two accurate reports and a respectful comparison of shared values such as family, generosity, and community.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Explanation and news report, fact/opinion, comparison, author purpose, supporting details, formal tone, and compound-complex sentences.
